scope.counts_are: Abegg/ETCBC displayed reading with Puech entry boundaries; not counts of Puech's readings, independent deposits or authenticated original letters
scope.unflagged_rule: Exclude every nonempty display class and explicit ◦/…; conservative notation sensitivity, not manuscript authentication

flag_definitions.c: supplied or corrected by modern editor
flag_definitions.s: written above the line by the scribe

feature_definitions.dema: Lemma דמע; ritual/tribute meaning remains interpretation-dependent.
feature_definitions.vessels: Lemma כלי; a listed object, not a proven deposit container.
feature_definitions.silver: Lemma כסף; no inference about whether a following unit weighs silver.
feature_definitions.gold: Lemma זהב; no inference about whether a following unit weighs gold.
feature_definitions.kk: Exact displayed token ככ; no expansion imposed.
feature_definitions.kkrin: Exact displayed token ככרין; full plural unit spelling.
feature_definitions.kkr: Exact displayed token ככר; singular, partly restored here.
feature_definitions.written_record_suffix: Exact וכתבן/כתבן; five full formulas plus bare II5.
feature_definitions.written_record_noun: Lemma כתב outside suffix tokens; final הכתב.
feature_definitions.book_or_scroll: Lemma ספר; VI5 and VIII3 have different contexts.
feature_definitions.ingots: Lemma עשת; object denomination, not a weight unit.
feature_definitions.garments: Lemma לבוש; edition alternatives retained in accompanying note.
feature_definitions.apudah: Lemma אפדה; garment/ephod interpretation is conditional.
feature_definitions.tithe: Lemma מעשר (surface מעסר); second-tithe phrase crosses I10–11.

retained_adjacent_meanings: מפי גל: from mouth of heap (Milik)
explicit_second_tithe.ref: text/readings.json#e4-disqualified; Phase1 entry4; ritual status attaches only under first branch

unit_comparisons.inference: Parallel syntax and equal numerals permit abbreviation hypothesis; distinct deposits with equal numerals do not prove equal units.
Uniform literal expansion כסף כרש requires a valuation or metal-dependent convention here; generic karsh remains distinct from literal silver-karsh expansion.

interpretation_checks.claim: The document adopts an inventory/retrieval form
interpretation_checks.result: compatible as a descriptive textual-form classification
interpretation_checks.reason: Listed objects, measures, local instructions and final duplicate-document wording survive removing all flagged hits; the disputed five-record formula is unnecessary for this conclusion.

interpretation_checks.claim: Five full formulas identify written accounts kept beside the deposits
interpretation_checks.reason: The Abegg כ reading permits written records; retained ב/locative readings permit distance or next-entry directions. A displayed unflagged token is not manuscript authentication.

interpretation_checks.claim: The inventory belonged specifically to the Jerusalem Temple
surviving_models: earmarked offerings held by contributors or administrators
interpretation_checks.reason: Ritual/accounting vocabulary is compatible with multiple owners; the displayed data supplies neither an authenticated ownership label nor a discriminating archaeological deposit.

interpretation_checks.claim: The unit/quantity evidence identifies origin or verifies actual deposits
interpretation_checks.reason: ככ expansion, corrected full spellings, quantity readings and object-versus-weight counts remain conditional; no total mass or owner follows.

interpretation_checks.claim: A named or ancient landmark dates compilation/deposition of the entire scroll
interpretation_checks.reason: Feature identification, phase, use at the time described, text copying and cave deposition remain separate dependencies; reused place names and ruins may outlast their construction.

refs: DJDIII D10–D11 pp263–264/C201 p257 (prior notes only)
chronology_controls.available_observation: Josephus's retrospective pre-destruction Jerusalem description names Solomon's pool; it does not establish Secacah's reservoir or the date of that reservoir's name.
Published foundation coin dates69/70CE; accepting that context supplies a lower installation bound for that particular floor.
chronology_controls.conditional_text_bound: Only an instruction referring to this built phase requires the described-use/deposit model to accommodate construction after coin minting.
